task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the payload_range_safety_spec.txt file on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Desktop/payload_range_safety_spec.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent configures GMAT with EarthFixed coordinate system and SphericalAZFPA state type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI windows showing 'EarthFixed' selected in Coordinate System and 'SphericalAZFPA' in the Spacecraft state representation.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the Force Model to include Earth gravity and atmospheric drag.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Propagator' or 'ForceModel' configuration panel showing 'Atmosphere' (e.g., JacchiaRoberts or MSISE90) and 'Gravity' enabled.

task_completion.description: Agent performs simulations for the three specified drag coefficients (Cd = 2.2, 1.2, 3.2).
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT script editor or GUI showing the Cd value being modified or a script loop iterating through 2.2, 1.2, and 3.2.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the simulation script to the specified output directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing 'splashdown_sim.script' exists in ~/GMAT_output/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the dispersion_results.txt file with the required formatting and data for all three cases.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing 'dispersion_results.txt' with CASE 1, 2, and 3 headers, including Latitude, Longitude, and Time of Flight values.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT graphical interface for the simulation rather than just writing a text file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT application window active and being interacted with (e.g., Mission Tree, Resource Tree).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy the 'privileged' bounds but derived specific values from the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final report contains specific decimal values (e.g., 31.7) rather than just the range bounds (25.0-36.0).

integrity.description: The agent did not create the results file before running the GMAT simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamp of the GMAT execution/output in the console precedes the final saving of dispersion_results.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The simulation must use EarthFixed/SphericalAZFPA. Verified splashdown values should fall within these ranges: Latitude [25.0, 36.0] and Longitude [-73.0, -60.0]. Case 2 (Cd=1.2) should result in the furthest downrange impact (most negative longitude), while Case 3 (Cd=3.2) should result in the shortest time of flight and impact closest to the launch point.
